usedFor: Kylas CRM holds your sales deals and More Good Reviews collects feedback, so “New Deal” can run “Create Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal” in Kylas CRM, then “Create Customer” in More Good Reviews
bestTemplate.why: Each deal adds its customer to More Good Reviews, so review requests have someone to go to.

watchOut: “New Deal” fires when a deal is generated, not won, so customers can be added before they have bought.
